name: scroll-progress-ring
title: Scroll Progress Ring
description: Reading progress drawn as an SVG ring around a fixed badge: the stroke fills clockwise with scroll progress, the percentage ticks in tabular numerals in the centre, and clicking it scrolls back to top.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Scroll Progress Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
